title.narrative: Preparatory Study for OpenChurch Project Uganda

description.narrative: The project's core objective is to empower young adults, fostering their self-confidence, self-reliance, and positive contribution to society. It places a strong emphasis on inclusivity, democracy, and collaboration. Through weekly events, mentoring, social gatherings and opportunities for volunteerism and community service, the proposed project aims to create a growth-environment where young people become confident in their own identity and find their place in society. The preparatory study aims to lay the groundwork for a future project, which will create a structures and sustainable youth work in collaboration with OCPU. Through the preparatory study we want to identify core youth leaders for the future project through training and teambuilding. We also want to build connections to other organisations or educational institutions for future collaboration.
